$schema.description: The address of this JSON schema, for editors; codeint does not read it.

source_sets.description: Globs of repository-relative paths that put files into a Source set, whatever the Source set rules say. When globs of several Source sets match one file, the first of vendored, generated, test, and production wins.

budgets.description: The highest ratio each Metric may reach in each Source set; a Metric over its Budget fails the run with exit code 1. A ratio equal to its Budget passes. Codeint compares the ratio as the report shows it, rounded to 4 decimal places.

new_file_budgets.description: The highest ratio each Metric may reach across newly added files in codeint diff, per Source set; a Metric over its new-file Budget fails codeint diff with exit code 1. A ratio equal to its Budget passes. Codeint compares the ratio as the report shows it, rounded to 4 decimal places.

regression_limits.description: How much each Metric may get worse from the merge-base to the head side before codeint diff reports a Regression and exits with code 1. A key named after a Metric sets its limit in every Source set; a key named after a Source set sets limits for that Source set only. For each setting, the limit of the Source set wins over the limit of the Metric, and a setting left out keeps the default: a ratio rise of 0.01, and numerator_rise (direct numerator rise), except for Import cycles, Boundaries, Orphan files, Hazards, and Dependency hygiene, where any_new_finding (plus numerator rise) applies.

languages.description: Which Language plugin measures which folders. Each entry names a Language plugin, the globs of the folders or files it measures, and the globs it leaves out. Several entries may name one Language plugin; it measures what any of them includes. Without this key, every Language plugin measures the whole repository; with it, a Language plugin measures only what its entries include.

plugins.description: External WebAssembly component Language and Metric plugins to load from local paths or HTTPS URLs. Each entry names the plugin, its optional kind (language by default, or metric), either its local path or its HTTPS url, and its required SHA-256 hex digest.

plugin_limits.description: Memory cap and time limit enforced on each WebAssembly Plugin. Defaults are 64 MiB and 5000 ms.

boundaries.description: Architectural import boundaries defining named zones, optional public_files entry points, directional internal allow or deny rules, external package allow_external or deny_external glob rules, and optional strict_zones mode.

dependencies.description: Dependency hygiene settings, including the allowlist of external package names excluded from unused, unlisted, and dev-in-production Findings.

duplication.description: Settings for Duplication detection, including opt-in shingle-based near-clone detection. Exact Clone groups remain the default when omitted.

entry_points.description: Globs of repository-relative paths treated as additional Production entry points for Orphan files detection, combined with manifest-discovered entry points.

coverage_reports.description: Paths relative to the repository root of LCOV or Cobertura XML Coverage reports used to measure Test gap.

sql.description: SQL settings, including Dialect mappings for folders or files.

hazards.description: Hazards Metric settings, including Hazard line rules turned off across the repository.

framework_profiles.description: Global Framework profile selection: false to disable all, true for auto-detection, a list of profile names (or {"only": [...]}), or {"exclude": [...]}. Omitted uses automatic detection.

packages.description: Per-Workspace-package configuration overrides keyed by repository-relative package root (or "." for the repository root).

ratchet.description: Ratchet settings, including an optional repository-relative path for the Ratchet file (.codeint/ratchet.json by default).

ratio_rise.description: The highest rise of the ratio, from 0 to 1, as the report shows it, rounded to 4 decimal places. A rise equal to the limit passes.

new_findings.description: When new Findings or a numerator rise fail: any_new_finding fails on any new Finding or numerator rise; numerator_rise fails whenever the numerator rises (rounded to 4 decimal places), so a Finding that only moves passes; numerator_rise_with_new_findings is a deprecated alias for numerator_rise; never lets new Findings and numerator rises pass, so that with ratio_rise 1 this Metric never makes a Regression here.

plugin.description: The name of the Language plugin, such as typescript-javascript.

include.description: Globs of repository-relative folders or files that the Language plugin measures; a folder covers every file below it.

exclude.description: Globs of repository-relative folders or files inside the included ones that the Language plugin leaves out.

name.description: The name of the external Plugin.

kind.description: Whether the external Plugin is a Language plugin or a Metric plugin; language by default.

path.description: Path to the WebAssembly component file, relative to the repository root or absolute. Set either path or url, not both.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the WebAssembly component file. Set either path or url, not both.

sha256.description: The required 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the plugin file.

memory_mb.description: Maximum linear memory in MiB that a WebAssembly Plugin may allocate; 64 by default.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum wall-clock time in milliseconds for each WebAssembly Plugin call; 5000 by default.

preset.description: Optional built-in architecture preset ("layered" or "hexagonal") providing default zones and rules that can be overridden or extended by zones and rules.

zones.description: Named architectural zones, each defined by repository-relative path globs and optional public_files globs.

rules.description: Directional allow or deny import rules between architectural zones and for external packages.

strict_zones.description: When true, report files in evaluated Source sets that do not match any configured zone.

source_sets.description: Source sets evaluated by boundary rules; defaults to ["production"] when omitted or empty.

patterns.description: Repository-relative path globs that assign files to this architectural zone.

public_files.description: Optional repository-relative path globs naming the only files in this zone that other zones may import.

from.description: Source zone name, or "*" to match any zone without a specific rule.

allow.description: Target zone names (or "*") that the source zone is allowed to import. Mutually exclusive with deny.

deny.description: Target zone names (or "*") that the source zone is forbidden to import. Mutually exclusive with allow.

allow_external.description: External package name globs that the source zone is allowed to import (use [] to forbid all third-party packages while still permitting standard-library built-ins). Mutually exclusive with deny_external.

deny_external.description: External package name globs that the source zone is forbidden to import. Mutually exclusive with allow_external.

reason.description: Optional human-readable explanation shown in boundary Findings.

ignore.description: Canonical external package names excluded from unused, unlisted, and dev-in-production dependency Findings.

near_clones.description: When true, detect near-duplicate code blocks using shingle similarity in addition to exact Clone groups; false by default.

min_similarity.description: Minimum Jaccard shingle similarity in (0, 1] required for two blocks to match as a near-clone; 0.85 by default.

dialects.description: Folder or file patterns mapped to a SQL Dialect (postgresql, mysql, sqlite, or duckdb). Files covered by no entry use generic SQL.

dialect.description: SQL Dialect for matching files: postgresql, mysql (including MariaDB), sqlite, or duckdb.

include.description: Globs of repository-relative folders or files that use this SQL Dialect; a folder covers every file below it.

disabled_rules.description: Names of Hazard line rules turned off across the repository. A turned-off rule adds no Hazard line and no Finding.

exclude.description: Auto-detect Framework profiles except the named profiles.

only.description: Activate only the named Framework profiles.

framework_profiles.description: Framework profile selection for this Workspace package: false to disable all, true for auto-detection, a list of profile names (or {"only": [...]}), or {"exclude": [...]}.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root of the Ratchet file; .codeint/ratchet.json by default.
